_why: kilix-content's catalog contract requires an immutable remote commit to fetch from, and this game has no remote until the owner calls it complete. So the row is designed and left here; adding it to the catalog is a one-line change once a remote exists. Registering a row that points at nothing would be worse than not registering one.
